        if self.event:

    yield "data: world\n\n"

        assert response.status_code == 200
        assert response.headers["content-type"] == "text/event-stream"

The `EventSourceResponse` class was added to `fastapi/responses.py` to provide built-in support for Server-Sent Events (SSE). This class inherits from `StreamingResponse` and automatically sets the required SSE headers: `Content-Type: text/event-stream`, `Cache-Control: no-cache`, and `Connection: keep-alive`.

```python
class EventSourceResponse(StreamingResponse):
    """
    SSE response.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        content,
        status_code: int = 200,
        headers: dict = None,
        background: Any = None,
    ):
        if headers is None:
            headers = {}
        headers["Cache-Control"] = "no-cache"
        headers["Connection"] = "keep-alive"
        super().__init__(
            content,
            status_code=status_code,
            headers=headers,
            background=background,
            media_type="text/event-stream",
        )
```
